generate_code.description: Whether to generate C code (true) or calculate checksums (false).

model.description: CRC parameter model to use (e.g., crc-32, crc-16-modbus, crc-5).

algorithm.description: Algorithm variant: bit-by-bit (bbb), bit-by-bit-fast (bbf), table-driven (tbl), or all.

std.description: C dialect for generated code: C89, ANSI, or C99.

generate_type.description: Code generation target: h (header), c (source), c-main (source with main), or table.

symbol_prefix.description: Prefix for exported C symbols. Leave empty for default naming.

crc_type.description: Type to use for crc_t in generated code. Leave empty for default.

include_files.description: List of header files to include in generated code.

slice_by.description: Speed-up table-driven calculation by operating on N octets (4, 8, or 16). 0 means disabled.

table_idx_width.description: Bits to use for CRC table indexing (1, 2, 4, or 8). 0 means default (8).

width.description: CRC width in bits. 0 means use model default.

poly.description: Polynomial in hex. 0 means use model default.

xor_in.description: Initial XOR value in hex. Empty means use model default.

xor_out.description: Final XOR value in hex. Empty means use model default.

output_file.description: Output file path for generated code. For checksum mode, this is ignored (uses /dev/null).

check_string.description: String to calculate checksum for. Empty means use model default ('123456789').

check_hexstring.description: Hex string to calculate checksum for.

check_file.description: File path to calculate checksum for.
